mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_identities (id, user_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email, provider_email_verified, linked_at, last_login_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, NULL, FALSE, #{linkedAt}, NULL)
mapper.sql: SELECT i.user_id, i.id AS identity_id, i.provider_user_id AS login_id, c.password_hash FROM auth_identities i JOIN users u ON u.id = i.user_id JOIN password_credentials c ON c.user_id = i.user_id
